kebab_example: aliyun arms get-source-map-info --id atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf0000/0.0.0/test.sourcemap.js --keyword test --order-field version --ascending-sequence true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --edition 0.0.0 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSourceMapInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SourceMap file
parameters.help_zh: SourceMap的ID标识串。格式为：`pid/sourcemap文件版本/sourcemap文件名`
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The keyword in the file name. The files are searched by keyword
parameters.help_zh: 文件名中的关键字，按照关键字进行过滤查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The criterion by which the files are sorted. Valid values:

version: The files are sorted by version.
uploadTime: The files are sorted by upload time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段：

version：以版本进行排序。
uploadTime：以上传时间排序
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en:
The order in which the files are sorted. Valid values:

true: ascending order
false: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
是否正序排序：

true：正序排序。
false：逆序排序
parameters.name: ascending_sequence

parameters.help_en: The version of the SourceMap file
parameters.name: edition
